caption: A rowing boat drifts across a clear shallow bay in sunshine, and its shadow slides along the sandy bottom beneath it.

sa.check: A rowing boat drifts across a clear shallow bay in sunshine.
Its shadow slides along the sandy bottom beneath it.
The shadow keeps the boat's outline.
The shadow lies on the side away from the sun.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the sea floor away from the sun and moves with the boat.
pc.fail: It lags behind; or floats on the surface; or points toward the sun.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the boat's outline.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or splits; or is a plain blob.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the boat still; or drifts across the sand by itself.

pc.expect: The boat floats at the surface and the shadow lies on the bottom.
pc.fail: The boat sinks; or the shadow rises off the sand; or the boat lifts out of the water.
A second boat or shadow appears; or the boat vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid.

pc.expect: The boat and the bay stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The boat changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the sand changes.
